dom.scene: A hilltop observatory visitor terrace at blue hour. She leans lightly beside a public telescope, one relaxed hand on its adjustment ring and the other resting on the railing, pausing to gaze at the rising crescent moon. Violet twilight and a dim amber observatory light on her face, calm traveling moment. Both hands visible in the waist-up composition.
dom.outfit: A sleeveless white high-neck cropped knit top, navy linen trousers, an open lightweight indigo shawl loosely draped off the shoulders, small spiral earrings. Bare arms and a band of midriff, contemporary travel fashion, no armor.
